parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.82), the two methods — `calculatesWorkloadReduction` (line 427) and `recordsInterpolatorResets` (line 461) — test distinct behavioural contracts of `QualityMetricsAggregator` (workload-reduction calculation vs. interpolator-reset recording). Near-duplicate structure in test methods is expected and intentional: each test follows the same arrange-act-assert skeleton while exercising a different code path, and collapsing them would obscure the distinct failure signals they are designed to surface.
